core_definitions.A: canonical well-typed active primitive family with exact indices
core_definitions.B1: typed raw extension retaining extras; Comp_raw preserves raw; isomorphism and stages compare N(raw)
core_definitions.B2: typed raw extension retaining extras; stages compare all raw indexed coordinates; uses strengthened raw isomorphism
core_definitions.N: restriction of raw primitive families to declared, profile-available active kinds
core_definitions.i: canonical inclusion of A as a raw presentation with no surplus primitive coordinates
core_definitions.identity_scope: set-sized fixed Stage-VI and shared-signature comparison family; equality of set-coded presentations is distinct from carrier-renaming isomorphism

formal_results.statement: N∘i=id_A when i is a canonical raw embedding of every well-typed A core
formal_results.proof: For each active core a, i(a) adds no surplus; restriction N recovers exactly all active coordinates.

formal_results.statement: B/~_N is bijective with A for ~_N defined by equality of N images
formal_results.proof: Because N is surjective by R1, the induced map [P]↦N(P) is well-defined, injective and surjective.
formal_results.scope: equality of normalized presentations, not general iso-class quotient

formal_results.statement: An observation T:B→Y factors as Tbar∘N iff it is constant on every fiber of N
formal_results.proof: Forward: equal N images imply equal T. Reverse: define Tbar(a)=T(i(a)); P and i(N(P)) lie in the same fiber, hence T(P)=Tbar(N(P)).
formal_results.scope: set-sized fixed family and a canonical section i; all observations are functions

formal_results.statement: Any finite or infinite family of tests factoring through N cannot distinguish two raw presentations in the same N-fiber
formal_results.proof: Each factorized test has equal outputs on P,Q with N(P)=N(Q); apply pointwise to all tests.
formal_results.scope: active-only tests; not true for raw metadata queries

formal_results.statement: Raw strict isomorphism implies active strict isomorphism, converse may fail
formal_results.proof: Raw preservation implies active substructure preservation; a one-point inherited carrier with differing undeclared Ap raw key supplies counterexample.
formal_results.scope: under typed raw extras and B2 strengthened strict

formal_results.statement: Red_raw(Comp_raw(P))=P and Comp_raw(Red_raw(F))=F for full models defined by deterministic C1
formal_results.proof: Comp_raw(P)=(P,Derived(N(P))) retains P; Red_raw projects raw P. Full models are exactly structures where derived=Derived(N(P)).

formal_results.statement: I4act=I5act and I4raw=I5raw under respective coherent comparator definitions
formal_results.proof: C1 derived coordinates are functions of active data, preserved by either stage-4 comparator; stage-5 adds no new independent test.
formal_results.scope: I4act corresponds to original strict; I4raw to strengthened raw strict, never mix
